result:
Confirmed: all "Role" occurrences in `scripts/` are inside string literals (documentation text), not real type usages — those files are excluded.

Based on a full-repo search, here are the files that actually name the `Role` type (via import, type annotation, type argument, or `Record` key position) — as opposed to files that merely read/pass a `.role` property or a bare string literal:

**Type-definition and direct consumers in `src/`:**
- `src/types/member.ts` — defines `Role`, uses it in `Record<Role, number>` and function signatures
- `src/types/feature-flag.ts` — imports `Role`, uses in `FlagContext`
- `src/types/permission.ts` — imports `Role`, uses in `targetRole: Role`
- `src/types/event.ts` — imports `Role`, uses in event payload types
- `src/app/(dashboard)/[orgSlug]/settings/members/page.tsx` — imports `Role`, uses in `changeRole(... role: Role)`
- `src/emails/invite-email.tsx` — imports `Role`, uses in props type
- `src/server/repositories/member-repository.ts` — imports `Role`, uses as param type
- `src/server/db/seed.ts` — imports `Role`, uses in array type annotation
- `src/server/services/member-service.ts` — imports `Role`, uses as param type
- `src/schemas/role.ts` — imports `Role` for compile-time parity check with the zod enum
- `src/components/domain/member/invite-member-form.tsx` — imports `Role`, uses as `useState<Role>` type argument
- `src/components/domain/member/role-select.tsx` — imports `Role`, uses in multiple annotations and a type assertion
- `src/components/domain/member/member-table.tsx` — imports `Role`, uses as callback param type
- `src/components/domain/permission/role-badge.tsx` — imports `Role`, uses in `Record<Role, ...>`
- `src/lib/permissions.ts` — imports `Role`, uses in `Record<PermissionAction, Role>`
- `src/lib/format.ts` — imports `Role`, uses in `Record<Role, string>` and function param

**Test files that import/annotate with `Role`:**
- `tests/contract/permissions.test.ts`
- `tests/config/nav.test.ts`
- `tests/server/_support/fixtures.ts`
- `tests/components/command-groups.test.ts`
- `tests/components/role-select.test.ts`
- `tests/lib/permissions.matrix.test.ts`

Excluded (checked but out of scope): files that only pass `.role`/`targetRole` as bare property values (e.g. `settings/layout.tsx`, `_support.ts`, `remove-member.ts`), files using zod schemas (`roleSchema`/`invitableRoleSchema`) rather than the TS `Role` type (`schemas/invitation.ts`, `schemas/member.ts`, `schemas/member.schema.test.ts`), files using unrelated `ROLE_RANK`/`ROLES` value constants without importing the `Role` type (`lib/feature-flags.ts`, `format.test.ts`), files using testing-library's ARIA `getByRole` (unrelated), and `scripts/manifest-parts/*.ts` where "Role" only appears inside documentation string literals.

ANSWER: src/types/member.ts, src/types/feature-flag.ts, src/types/permission.ts, src/types/event.ts, src/app/(dashboard)/[orgSlug]/settings/members/page.tsx, src/emails/invite-email.tsx, src/server/repositories/member-repository.ts, src/server/db/seed.ts, src/server/services/member-service.ts, src/schemas/role.ts, src/components/domain/member/invite-member-form.tsx, src/components/domain/member/role-select.tsx, src/components/domain/member/member-table.tsx, src/components/domain/permission/role-badge.tsx, src/lib/permissions.ts, src/lib/format.ts, tests/contract/permissions.test.ts, tests/config/nav.test.ts, tests/server/_support/fixtures.ts, tests/components/command-groups.test.ts, tests/components/role-select.test.ts, tests/lib/permissions.matrix.test.ts
